source.product: MOD13Q1.061 _250m_16_days_NDVI, NASA ORNL MODIS Web Service point subset at Benguet Strawberry Farm, La Trinidad, monthly mean of good- and marginal-reliability 16-day observations

scaleNote: This is a 250 m Terra MODIS NDVI point sample at the mapped Strawberry Farm in La Trinidad, Benguet, averaged from good- or marginal-reliability 16-day observations by month. The playback panel shows each month's good/marginal composite counts; thinly sampled months warrant caution. NDVI measures vegetation greenness, not strawberry yield, crop loss, or the condition of every vegetable farm. A paired Aqua MODIS series is an independent sensor cross-check, not a calibrated correction or proof of orbital-drift bias. Regional event reports provide context, not proof that an event caused its reading.

qualityPolicy.monthlyCounts: Each monthly record stores accepted good and marginal 16-day composite counts used in its mean.

continuity.method: Linear interpolation of interior gaps up to two months for sonification only; source observations remain unchanged. The chart uses dotted links across all missing intervals.

terraAquaCrossCheck.mission: Terra MODIS MOD13Q1.061 and Aqua MODIS MYD13Q1.061
terraAquaCrossCheck.method: Independent 250 m point subsets at the same coordinate, each using monthly means of good- and marginal-reliability 16-day observations (reliability 0 or 1).
terraAquaCrossCheck.caveat: Terra and Aqua are separate sensors with different overpass times and compositing inputs; differences are not a calibrated correction or proof of orbital-drift bias.
